metric_note: metrics.json records result-derived reference values; the GUI evaluator reads the native solver artifacts and does not require this sidecar.
note: The ANSYS 3D transient thermal model/result pair passed the native MAPDL evaluator with verified K/C/density, 2 mm mesh evidence, X=4/X=6 probes, complete left-face 100 C constraint, transient solution type, and a physically decreasing t=10 s temperature profile. A real-solver uniform-100 C negative result was rejected. The isolated Abaqus candidate used a 5 mm mesh with only 160 elements and was removed.
